login.title: Sign in to Mesta
login.description: Use your organization's work account to access your pricing workspace.
login.emailError: Enter a valid work email address.
login.securityNote: Your organization manages authentication and MFA.
login.helpBody: Contact your Mesta administrator or IT service desk. Mesta never asks for your password.
login.signedOut: You have signed out of Mesta.
login.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
login.revoked: Your session was ended by an administrator.
login.orgFound: Sign in through your organization's identity provider.
login.unknownTitle: We couldn't identify your organization from this email address.
login.unknownBody: Contact your Mesta administrator for access.
login.notConfiguredTitle: Your organization is not configured for Mesta SSO.
login.notConfiguredBody: Ask your administrator to connect an identity provider for {org}.
login.demoHint: Demo accounts: rina@mesta.id (analyst), budi@mesta.id (manager, several workspaces), andre@mesta.id, sari@mesta.id, dewi@mesta.id, name@mestagroup.com (two organizations).

idp.explain: This page stands in for your organization’s identity provider in the demo build. In production you are sent to {provider} and return to Mesta automatically.
idp.mfaBody: Approve the sign-in request on your registered device.
idp.invalid: This sign-in request is incomplete. Start again from Mesta.

error.title: We couldn't complete sign-in.
error.invalid_response: The sign-in response could not be verified. Start sign-in again.
error.provider_unavailable: Your organization's sign-in service is currently unavailable.
error.account_disabled: Your Mesta access has been disabled.
error.not_configured: Your organization is not configured for Mesta SSO.
error.not_provisioned: Your identity was verified, but you don't have access to Mesta.
error.session_failed: Your session could not be established.
error.contact: Contact your Mesta administrator if this keeps happening.

workspaces.title: Select a workspace
workspaces.none: You don't have access to any workspace.

session.warningTitle: Your session is about to expire.
session.warningBody: Continue working? You will be signed out in {time}.

denied.title: You don't have permission to open this page.
denied.contact: Contact your administrator or pricing manager.
denied.requested: Access request sent to your administrator.
